Repository instructions
This is a TypeScript + Three.js application using SparkJS for 3D Gaussian Splat rendering.
For the current renderer migration investigation, ONLY inspect files under src/.
Do not inspect, summarize, or modify generated files, build output, dependencies, assets, or unrelated repository files unless explicitly required.
Prefer targeted search and small relevant file reads over broad repository exploration.
Do not read an entire file when a relevant function, class, import section, or symbol is sufficient.
Do not make code changes during analysis unless explicitly requested.
Preserve the existing UI and application architecture unless analysis demonstrates that a change is required.
Separate SparkJS-specific APIs from ordinary Three.js APIs and application-level abstractions.
Be concise. Do not repeat information already established.
For analysis tasks, prioritize actionable findings, file paths, symbols, dependencies, and unknowns over lengthy explanations.
Do not speculate when the source code or renderer documentation can establish the answer.
